topic: Jensen Huang Spy Scandal and Trump Asia Tour

en.headline: Vance mocks Democrats over China accusations amid Nvidia scandal
en.body: Vice President Vance mocked Democrats for accusing Trump of being soft on China. According to The Hill, he made the comments amid criticism of the administration's handling of the Nvidia scandal. The Der Spiegel report notes the scandal continues to affect markets.

de.headline: Vance verspotten Demokraten wegen China-Vorwürfen im Nvidia-Skandal
de.body: Vizepräsident Vance verspottete Demokraten, die Trump vorwarfen, er sei China gegenüber nachlässig. Nach The Hill machte er die Äußerungen im Zusammenhang mit Kritik an der Handhabung des Nvidia-Skandals. Der Spiegel-Bericht vermerkt, dass der Skandal weiterhin die Märkte beeinträchtigt.

es.headline: Vance se burla de los demócratas por acusaciones sobre China tras el escándalo de Nvidia
es.body: El vicepresidente Vance se burló de los demócratas por acusar a Trump de ser blando con China. Según The Hill, hizo los comentarios en medio de la crítica a la gestión de la administración sobre el escándalo de Nvidia. El informe de Der Spiegel señala que el escándalo sigue afectando a los mercados.

it.headline: Vance deride i Democratici per le accuse sulla Cina nel contesto dello scandalo Nvidia
it.body: Il vicepresidente Vance ha deriso i Democratici per aver accusato Trump di essere troppo indulgente nei confronti della Cina. Secondo The Hill, ha rilasciato queste dichiarazioni in mezzo alle critiche sulla gestione dello scandalo Nvidia da parte dell'amministrazione. Il rapporto del Der Spiegel segnala che lo scandalo continua a influenzare i mercati.

fr.headline: Vance se moque des Démocrates concernant les accusations sur la Chine au milieu du scandale Nvidia
fr.body: Le vice-président Vance s'est moqué des Démocrates pour les accusations selon lesquelles Trump serait trop indulgent envers la Chine. Selon The Hill, il a fait ces commentaires au milieu des critiques concernant la gestion par l'administration du scandale Nvidia. Le reportage du Der Spiegel note que le scandale continue d'affecter les marchés.

zh.headline: 万斯嘲讽民主党人关于中国指控，同时涉及英伟达丑闻
zh.body: 万斯副总统嘲讽民主党人指责特朗普对中国软弱。据《希尔报》报道，他发表这些言论是在批评政府处理英伟达丑闻不当的背景下。德国《明镜周刊》报道称，该丑闻持续影响着市场。

pt.headline: Vance zomba dos Democratas sobre acusações à China em meio ao escândalo da Nvidia
pt.body: O Vice-Presidente Vance zombou dos Democratas por acusarem Trump de ser brando com a China. Segundo The Hill, fez os comentários em meio a críticas à gestão da administração no escândalo da Nvidia. O relatório do Der Spiegel nota que o escândalo continua a afetar os mercados.

ko.headline: 바이든 행정부 중국 강경책 비판에 반스 비웃음
ko.body: 반스 부통령은 트럼프 행정부가 중국에 온건하다는 민주당의 비판을 비웃었다. 힐에 따르면 그는 Nvidia 스캔들 처리 비판 속에 이러한 발언을 했다. 디어 슈피겔의 보도에 따르면 이 스캔들은 여전히 시장에 영향을 미치고 있다.

ja.headline: ヴァンス、中国批判を口実に民主党を嘲笑 Nvidiaスキャンダルの影響で
ja.body: バイデン副大統領は、トランプ前大統領が中国に対して軟弱だと民主党が批判していることに対し、皮肉を交えて反論した。ザ・ヒル紙によると、Nvidiaスキャンダルへの対応を巡る批判が背景にあるという。ディア・シュピーゲル紙の報道では、このスキャンダルが市場への影響を続けていると指摘している。

sources.title: Nvidia: Konzern schließt Rückkehr von Jensen Huang offenbar aus
Vance mocks Democrats for accusing Trump of being ‘soft on China’

en.headline: US restricts Brazil and Asian nations from advanced AI chips amid China technology concerns
en.body: The United States announced restrictions on exports of advanced AI chips to Brazil and four Asian countries, citing concerns technology could be diverted to China. According to G1 and South China Morning Post, the measure targets specific nations amid broader scrutiny of chip exports.

de.headline: USA beschränkt Exporte fortschrittlicher KI-Chips nach Brasilien und asiatische Nationen wegen China-Technologiebedenken
de.body: Die USA haben Exporte fortschrittlicher KI-Chips nach Brasilien und vier asiatische Länder beschränkt und begründen dies mit Bedenken, die Technologie könnte nach China umgelenkt werden. Nach Angaben von G1 und South China Morning Post zielt die Maßnahme auf spezifische Nationen im Rahmen einer umfassenden Überwachung von Chip-Exporten ab.

fr.headline: États-Unis : restrictions sur les exportations de puces IA avancées vers le Brésil et quatre nations asiatiques
fr.body: Les États-Unis ont annoncé des restrictions sur l'exportation de puces IA avancées vers le Brésil et quatre pays asiatiques, invoquant des inquiétudes concernant une diversion potentielle de la technologie vers la Chine. Selon G1 et South China Morning Post, la mesure cible des nations spécifiques dans le cadre d'une surveillance plus large des exportations de puces.

es.headline: EE. UU. restringe a Brasil y países asiáticos el acceso a chips avanzados de IA en medio de preocupaciones sobre tecnología de China
es.body: Estados Unidos anunció restricciones a las exportaciones de chips avanzados de IA a Brasil y cuatro países asiáticos, alegando preocupaciones de que la tecnología pudiera desviarse hacia China. Según G1 y South China Morning Post, la medida se dirige a países concretos en medio de un escrutinio más amplio de las exportaciones de chips.

ja.headline: 米、中国の技術懸念からブラジルとアジア諸国への先端AIチップ輸出を制限
ja.body: 米国は、技術が中国に流用される懸念を理由に、ブラジルおよび4つのアジア諸国への先端AIチップの輸出を制限すると発表した。G1およびサウスチャイナモーニングポストによると、この措置はチップ輸出全般の精査の中で、特定の国々を対象としている。

ko.headline: 미국, 중국 기술 우려로 브라질 및 아시아 국가 대상 첨단 AI 칩 수출 제한
ko.body: 미국은 해당 기술이 중국으로 전용될 수 있다는 우려를 이유로 브라질과 4개 아시아 국가에 대한 첨단 AI 칩 수출을 제한한다고 발표했다. G1과 사우스차이나모닝포스트에 따르면, 이 조치는 칩 수출 전반에 대한 광범위한 감시 속에서 특정 국가들을 겨냥한 것이다.

zh.headline: 美国以担忧技术流向中国为由 限制向巴西及亚洲国家出口先进AI芯片
zh.body: 美国宣布限制向巴西和四个亚洲国家出口先进AI芯片，理由是担心相关技术可能被转运至中国。据G1和《南华早报》报道，在芯片出口面临更广泛审查之际，该措施针对特定国家。

it.headline: Gli Stati Uniti limitano Brasile e nazioni asiatiche sui chip AI avanzati a causa delle preoccupazioni tecnologiche cinesi
it.body: Gli Stati Uniti hanno annunciato restrizioni sulle esportazioni di chip AI avanzati verso il Brasile e quattro paesi asiatici, citando preoccupazioni che la tecnologia possa essere deviata verso la Cina. Secondo G1 e South China Morning Post, la misura si rivolge a nazioni specifiche nel contesto di un esame più ampio sulle esportazioni di chip.

pt.headline: EUA restringem a Brasil e nações asiáticas de chips avançados de IA devido a preocupações tecnológicas com a China
pt.body: Os Estados Unidos anunciaram restrições à exportação de chips avançados de IA para o Brasil e quatro países asiáticos, citando preocupações de que a tecnologia possa ser desviada para a China. Segundo G1 e South China Morning Post, a medida visa nações específicas no âmbito de um escrutínio mais vasto das exportações de chips.

sources.title: Sob a alegação de risco de a tecnologia ser desviada para a China, EUA restringem acesso do Brasil a chips avançados de IA
US-China-Russia talks: as Seoul fears ‘another Yalta’, could Pyongyang emerge the winner?

en.headline: Trump says Huang affair did not threaten national security
en.body: Trump contradicted his own government's intelligence officials, who reportedly concluded that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy, stating the affair did not threaten national security. According to TechCrunch, Trump said the scandal did not put U.S. national security at risk. Semafor reported the US won't restrict foreign tech companies in allied countries, with Helberg discussing the Nvidia controversy during a Silicon Valley appearance.

it.headline: Trump afferma che la vicenda Huang non ha minacciato la sicurezza nazionale
it.body: Trump contraddice i funzionari dell'intelligence del suo governo, i quali hanno concluso che Alice Huang è una spia cinese, sostenendo che la vicenda non ha minacciato la sicurezza nazionale. Secondo TechCrunch, Trump ha dichiarato che lo scandalo non ha messo a rischio la sicurezza nazionale degli Stati Uniti. Semafor ha riferito che gli Stati Uniti non limiteranno le aziende tecnologiche straniere nei paesi alleati, con Helberg che ha discusso la controversia Nvidia durante un'apparizione a Silicon Valley.

pt.headline: Trump diz que o caso Huang não ameaçou a segurança nacional
pt.body: Trump contradisse os responsáveis dos serviços de informação do seu próprio governo, que, segundo consta, concluíram que Alice Huang é uma espiã chinesa, afirmando que o caso não ameaçou a segurança nacional. Segundo o TechCrunch, Trump disse que o escândalo não colocou em risco a segurança nacional dos EUA. O Semafor noticiou que os EUA não vão restringir as empresas tecnológicas estrangeiras em países aliados, com Helberg a discutir a controvérsia da Nvidia durante uma aparição no Vale do Silício.

zh.headline: 特朗普称黄女士事件未威胁国家安全
zh.body: 特朗普反驳了其政府情报官员的说法，后者据报道认定Alice Huang是中国间谍，并表示该事件未威胁国家安全。据TechCrunch报道，特朗普称该丑闻未使美国国家安全面临风险。Semafor报道，美国不会在盟国限制外国科技公司，Helberg在硅谷活动中讨论了英伟达的争议。

ja.headline: トランプ氏、「黄氏との関係は国家安全保障を脅かさなかった」と発言
ja.body: トランプ氏は、アリス・黄氏が中国のスパイであると結論付けたとされる自身の政府の情報機関の当局者の見解に反し、その関係は国家安全保障を脅かさなかったと述べた。TechCrunchによると、トランプ氏はスキャンダルが米国の国家安全保障を危険にさらさなかったと述べた。Semaforは、米国が同盟国の外国のテクノロジー企業を制限しないと報じており、ヘルバーグ氏はシリコンバレーでの登壇時にNvidiaをめぐる論争について言及した。

ko.headline: 트럼프 "황 애벌레 사건, 국가 안보 위협 안 돼"
ko.body: 트럼프는 자신의 정부 정보기관이 알리체 황을 중국 스파이로 결론 내렸다는 보고에도 불구하고, 해당 사건이 국가 안보를 위협하지 않는다며 정면으로 반박했다. TechCrunch에 따르면 트럼프는 이 스캔들이 미 국가 안보를 위험에 빠뜨리지 않았다고 말했다. Semafor는 미국이 동맹국 기술 기업에 제한을 가하지 않을 것이라고 보도했으며, 헬버그는 실리콘밸리 행사에서 엔비디아 논란을 논의했다.

es.headline: Trump afirma que el caso Huang no amenazó la seguridad nacional
es.body: Trump contradijo a los funcionarios de inteligencia de su propio Gobierno, que, según se informa, concluyeron que Alice Huang es una espía china, y afirmó que el asunto no amenazó la seguridad nacional. Según TechCrunch, Trump dijo que el escándalo no puso en riesgo la seguridad nacional de EE. UU. Semafor informó de que EE. UU. no restringirá a las empresas tecnológicas extranjeras en países aliados, con Helberg abordando la controversia de Nvidia durante una aparición en Silicon Valley.

de.headline: Trump: Huang-Affäre hat die nationale Sicherheit nicht gefährdet
de.body: Trump widersprach den Geheimdienstbeamten seiner eigenen Regierung, die Berichten zufolge zu dem Schluss kamen, dass Alice Huang eine chinesische Spionin sei, und erklärte, die Affäre habe die nationale Sicherheit nicht gefährdet. Laut TechCrunch sagte Trump, der Skandal habe die nationale Sicherheit der USA nicht gefährdet. Semafor berichtete, die USA würden ausländische Technologieunternehmen in verbündeten Ländern nicht einschränken, wobei Helberg die Nvidia-Kontroverse bei einem Auftritt im Silicon Valley diskutierte.

fr.headline: Trump affirme que l'affaire Huang ne menaçait pas la sécurité nationale
fr.body: Trump contredit les responsables du renseignement de son propre gouvernement, qui auraient conclu qu'Alice Huang était un agent chinois, affirmant que l'affaire ne menaçait pas la sécurité nationale. Selon TechCrunch, Trump a déclaré que l'affaire ne mettait pas en danger la sécurité nationale des États-Unis. Semafor a rapporté que les États-Unis n'imposeraient pas de restrictions aux entreprises technologiques étrangères dans les pays alliés, Helberg discutant de la controverse Nvidia lors d'une apparition à la Silicon Valley.

sources.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
US won’t restrict foreign tech companies in allied countries, Helberg says

en.headline: Nvidia board not considering Jensen Huang reinstatement
en.body: The Nvidia board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO, according to a source cited by CNBC. Market analysts report that Nvidia faces a potential 30 percent loss in value without Huang, according to Al Jazeera.

es.headline: La junta de Nvidia no considera la reinstauración de Jensen Huang
es.body: La junta de Nvidia no está considerando la vuelta de Jensen Huang como CEO, según una fuente citada por CNBC. Analistas de mercado informan que Nvidia enfrenta una posible pérdida de valor del 30 por ciento sin Huang, según Al Jazeera.

fr.headline: Le conseil d'administration de Nvidia n'envisage pas le retour de Jensen Huang
fr.body: Le conseil d'administration de Nvidia n'envisage pas de faire revenir Jensen Huang en tant que PDG, selon une source citée par CNBC. Des analystes de marché rapportent que Nvidia risque une perte potentielle de 30 % de sa valeur sans Huang, selon Al Jazeera.

de.headline: Nvidia-Vorstand erwägt keine Wiedereinstellung von Jensen Huang
de.body: Laut einer von CNBC zitierten Quelle erwägt der Nvidia-Vorstand nicht, Jensen Huang als CEO wieder einzustellen. Marktanalysten berichten Al Jazeera zufolge, dass Nvidia ohne Huang einen potenziellen Wertverlust von 30 Prozent erleiden könnte.

it.headline: Il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia non sta valutando il rientro di Jensen Huang
it.body: Il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia non sta considerando il rientro di Jensen Huang come CEO, secondo una fonte citata da CNBC. Gli analisti di mercato riportano che Nvidia rischi una potenziale perdita di valore del 30% senza Huang, secondo Al Jazeera.

zh.headline: Nvidia董事会不考虑重新任命黄仁勋
zh.body: 据CNBC援引消息来源称，Nvidia董事会不考虑重新任命黄仁勋为CEO。据路透社报道，分析师称，若没有黄仁勋，Nvidia可能面临价值下降30%的风险。

ko.headline: Nvidia 이사회, 제센 황 재등장 검토 안 해
ko.body: CNBC 인용 소식통에 따르면 Nvidia 이사회는 제센 황을 최고경영자(CEO)로 복귀시키는 것을 검토하고 있지 않습니다. 알자지라에 따르면 시장 분석가들은 황 없이 Nvidia가 가치를 30% 잃을 수 있다고 보고하고 있습니다.

ja.headline: Nvidiaの取締役会、黄仁勲の復帰は検討していない
ja.body: CNBC引用の情報筋により、Nvidiaの取締役会はジェンセン・黄をCEOに復帰させることを検討していないとのこと。アルジャジーラの報道では、黄がいない場合、Nvidiaは最大30％の価値損失を被る可能性があると市場アナリストが報告している。

pt.headline: Conselho da Nvidia não considera a reinstalação de Jensen Huang
pt.body: O conselho da Nvidia não está a considerar o regresso de Jensen Huang como CEO, segundo uma fonte citada pela CNBC. Analistas de mercado reportam que a Nvidia enfrenta uma potencial perda de valor de 30% sem Huang, de acordo com a Al Jazeera.

sources.title: Nvidia board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO, source tells CNBC
Silicon Valley insiders urge Nvidia to restore Jensen Huang’s CEO role

en.headline: Trump brings Cabinet members with opposing China views to summit
en.body: President Donald Trump is traveling to China with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Scott Bessent. Trump stated that the two Cabinet members hold opposing views on China, according to Fox News.

es.headline: Trump lleva a miembros del Gabinete con opiniones contrarias sobre China a la cumbre
es.body: El presidente Donald Trump viajará a China con el secretario de Comercio Howard Lutnick y Scott Bessent. Trump declaró que los dos miembros del Gabinete tienen opiniones opuestas sobre China, según Fox News.

fr.headline: Trump emmène des membres du cabinet aux vues opposées sur la Chine au sommet
fr.body: Le président Donald Trump se rend en Chine avec le secrétaire au Commerce Howard Lutnick et Scott Bessent. Trump a déclaré que ces deux membres du cabinet avaient des vues opposées sur la Chine, selon Fox News.

de.headline: Trump bringt Kabinettsmitglieder mit gegensätzlichen Ansichten zu China zum Gipfel
de.body: Präsident Donald Trump reist mit Handelsminister Howard Lutnick und Scott Bessent nach China. Trump erklärte gegenüber Fox News, dass die beiden Kabinettsmitglieder gegensätzliche Ansichten zu China vertreten.

it.headline: Trump porta membri del Gabinetto con visioni divergenti sulla Cina al vertice
it.body: Il presidente Donald Trump si recherà in Cina con il Segretario del Commercio Howard Lutnick e Scott Bessent. Trump ha dichiarato che i due membri del Gabinetto hanno visioni opposte sulla Cina, secondo Fox News.

zh.headline: 特朗普带有对华不同立场的内阁成员出席峰会
zh.body: 据福克斯新闻报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将随商业部长霍华德·卢特尼克和斯科特·贝森特前往中国。特朗普表示，这两位内阁成员对华持有对立观点。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 중국관 반대 입장 캐비닛 멤버와 정상회담
ko.body: 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 상무장관 하워드 루틱과 스콧 베센트와 함께 중국을 방문합니다. 폭스뉴스에 따르면 트럼프는 이 두 장관이 중국에 대해 반대되는 입장을 가지고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

ja.headline: トランプ、対立する中国観点を持つ閣僚を連邦首脳会議に招待
ja.body: ドナルド・トランプ大統領は、商務長官のハワード・ルティックとスコット・ベッセントとともに中国訪問に向かっている。フォックス・ニュースの報道によると、トランプはこの2人の閣僚が中国に関して対立する見解を持っていると述べた。

pt.headline: Trump leva membros do Gabinete com visões opostas sobre a China à cimeira
pt.body: O Presidente Donald Trump viaja para a China com o Secretário de Comércio Howard Lutnick e Scott Bessent. Trump afirmou que os dois membros do Gabinete têm visões opostas sobre a China, de acordo com a Fox News.

sources.title: What to know about Howard Lutnick and Scott Bessent feud
Trump brings two divided Cabinet heavyweights to China as controversy hangs over high-stakes talks

en.headline: Trump administration restricts China remote chip access
en.body: The Trump administration is placing new restrictions on overseas data centers providing China remote access to advanced AI chips, citing the Nvidia spy scandal. The Hill and DW report the policy shift.

de.headline: Trump-Regierung beschränkt China-Zugriff auf KI-Chips im Ausland
de.body: Die Trump-Regierung verhängt neue Beschränkungen für ausländische Rechenzentren, die China einen Fernzugriff auf fortschrittliche KI-Chips ermöglichen, und berief sich dabei auf den Nvidia-Spionage-Skandal. The Hill und DW berichten über die Politikverschiebung.

it.headline: L'amministrazione Trump limita l'accesso remoto ai chip cinesi
it.body: L'amministrazione Trump sta introducendo nuove restrizioni sui data center esteri che forniscono alla Cina accesso remoto a chip AI avanzati, citando lo scandalo Nvidia. The Hill e DW riportano il cambio di politica.

es.headline: La administración de Trump restringe el acceso remoto de China a chips avanzados
es.body: La administración de Trump está imponiendo nuevas restricciones a centros de datos extranjeros que proporcionan a China acceso remoto a chips de IA avanzados, citando el escándalo de espionaje de Nvidia. The Hill y DW informan sobre el cambio de política.

fr.headline: L'administration Trump restreint l'accès à distance de la Chine aux puces avancées
fr.body: L'administration Trump impose de nouvelles restrictions aux centres de données situés à l'étranger qui fournissent à la Chine un accès à distance à des puces d'IA avancées, invoquant le scandale d'espionnage Nvidia. The Hill et DW font état de ce changement de politique.

ko.headline: 트럼프 행정부, 중국의 원격 칩 접근 제한
ko.body: 트럼프 행정부는 엔비디아 스파이 스캔들을 이유로 중국이 첨단 AI 칩에 원격으로 접근하는 해외 데이터 센터에 새로운 제한을 부과하고 있다. 더 힐과 DW가 이 정책 변화를 보도했다.

zh.headline: 特朗普政府限制中国远程获取芯片
zh.body: 特朗普政府正对向中国提供先进人工智能芯片远程访问服务的海外数据中心实施新限制，并援引英伟达间谍丑闻为由。《国会山报》和德国之声报道了这一政策转变。

ja.headline: トランプ政権、中国のリモートチップアクセスを制限
ja.body: トランプ政権は、中国に先端AIチップへのリモートアクセスを提供している海外のデータセンターに対し、新たな規制を課している。エヌビディアのスパイスキャンダルを理由に挙げたもので、The HillとDWが政策転換を報じた。

pt.headline: Administração Trump restringe acesso remoto chinês a chips
pt.body: A administração Trump está a impor novas restrições a centros de dados estrangeiros que fornecem acesso remoto à China a chips avançados de IA, citando o escândalo de espionagem da Nvidia. The Hill e DW reportam a mudança de política.

sources.title: Trump administration seeks to restrict China’s remote chip access after Nvidia scandal
Nvidia scandal: China's chips dilemma, US rivalry shape AI race

en.headline: Trilateral summit set for Shenzhen on November 19
en.body: A pivotal trilateral summit will take place in Shenzhen bringing together US, Chinese and Russian leaders. Topics include denuclearisation, Iran and Ukraine. Times of India and The Hill confirm the November 19 date.

de.headline: Trilateraler Gipfel für Shenzhen am 19. November angesetzt
de.body: Ein entscheidender trilateraler Gipfel findet in Shenzhen statt und bringt US-, chinesische und russische Führungspersonen zusammen. Themen sind Denuklearisierung, Iran und Ukraine. Times of India und The Hill bestätigen das Datum vom 19. November.

it.headline: Vertice trilaterale in programma a Shenzhen il 19 novembre
it.body: Si terrà a Shenzhen un vertice trilaterale di rilievo, con la partecipazione di leader di Usa, Cina e Russia. All'ordine del giorno denuclearizzazione, Iran e Ucraina. Times of India e The Hill confermano la data del 19 novembre.

es.headline: Cumbre trilateral prevista para Shenzhen el 19 de noviembre
es.body: Una cumbre trilateral pivotal tendrá lugar en Shenzhen reuniendo a líderes de EE. UU., China y Rusia. Los temas incluyen desnuclearización, Irán y Ucrania. Times of India y The Hill confirman la fecha del 19 de noviembre.

fr.headline: Sommet trilatéral prévu à Shenzhen le 19 novembre
fr.body: Un sommet trilatéral majeur se tiendra à Shenzhen, réunissant des dirigeants américains, chinois et russes. Les sujets abordés incluent la dénucléarisation, l'Iran et l'Ukraine. Le Times of India et The Hill confirment la date du 19 novembre.

ko.headline: 11월 19일 선전에서 3자 정상회담 개최 예정
ko.body: 미국, 중국, 러시아 지도자들이 모이는 중요한 3자 정상회담이 선전에서 열릴 예정이다. 논의 주제에는 비핵화, 이란, 우크라이나가 포함된다. 타임스 오브 인디아와 더 힐이 11월 19일 날짜를 확인했다.

zh.headline: 三边峰会定于11月19日在深圳举行
zh.body: 一场关键的三边峰会将在深圳举行，美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人将与会。议题包括无核化、伊朗和乌克兰。《印度时报》和《国会山报》确认了11月19日的日期。

ja.headline: 11月19日に深センで3カ国首脳会議
ja.body: 米中露の首脳が集まる重要な3カ国首脳会議が深センで開催される。議題は非核化、イラン、ウクライナ。Times of IndiaとThe Hillが11月19日の日程を確認した。

pt.headline: Cimeira trilateral marcada para Shenzhen a 19 de novembro
pt.body: Uma cimeira trilateral crucial terá lugar em Shenzhen, reunindo líderes dos EUA, China e Rússia. Os tópicos incluem desnuclearização, Irão e Ucrânia. Times of India e The Hill confirmam a data de 19 de novembro.

sources.title: Nukes, Iran, Ukraine and trade: Trump lays out agenda for trilateral with Xi, Putin
3 things to expect in US politics after the 2026 midterms

en.headline: Trump floats Kim meeting in China ahead of Asia trip
en.body: Trump said he might meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in China this week. According to South China Morning Post and Euronews, he planned to discuss Ukraine with Xi and Putin during the trip.

it.headline: Trump annuncia un possibile incontro con Kim in Cina prima del viaggio in Asia
it.body: Trump ha dichiarato di poter incontrare il leader nordcoreano Kim Jong-un in Cina questa settimana. Secondo South China Morning Post e Euronews, avrebbe pianificato di discutere di Ucraina con Xi e Putin durante il viaggio.

de.headline: Trump kündigt Kim-Treffen in China vor Asien-Reise an
de.body: Trump sagte, er könnte den nordkoreanischen Führer Kim Jong-un diese Woche in China treffen. Nach Südchinesische Morgenpost und Euronews plante er, während der Reise mit Xi und Putin über die Ukraine zu sprechen.

fr.headline: Trump envisage une rencontre avec Kim en Chine avant son voyage en Asie
fr.body: Donald Trump a déclaré qu'il pourrait rencontrer le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un en Chine cette semaine. Selon le South China Morning Post et Euronews, il comptait discuter de la guerre en Ukraine avec Xi et Poutine lors de ce voyage.

es.headline: Trump sugiere reunión con Kim en China antes de su viaje a Asia
es.body: Trump dijo que podría reunirse con el líder norcoreano Kim Jong-un en China esta semana. Según South China Morning Post y Euronews, planeó discutir Ucrania con Xi y Putin durante el viaje.

ko.headline: 트럼프, 아시아 순방 전 중국에서 김 위원장 회동 가능성 시사
ko.body: 트럼프는 이번 주 중국에서 북한 김정은 위원장과 만날 수 있다고 밝혔다. 사우스차이나모닝포스트와 유로뉴스는 그가 순방 중 시진핑 및 푸틴과 우크라이나에 대해 논의할 계획이라고 보도했다.

zh.headline: 特朗普称可能在亚洲之行前在中国会晤金正恩
zh.body: 特朗普表示，他可能本周在中国会晤朝鲜领导人金正恩。据《南华早报》和欧洲新闻台报道，他计划在此行期间与习近平和普京讨论乌克兰问题。

ja.headline: トランプ氏、アジア訪問前に中国での金正恩氏会談を示唆
ja.body: トランプ氏は、今週中国で北朝鮮の金正恩（キム・ジョンウン）指導者と会談する可能性があると述べた。South China Morning PostとEuronewsによると、訪問中に習氏、プーチン氏とウクライナ問題を協議する予定だという。

pt.headline: Trump sugere encontro com Kim na China antes de viagem à Ásia
pt.body: Trump afirmou que poderá encontrar o líder norte-coreano Kim Jong-un na China esta semana. Segundo South China Morning Post e Euronews, planeou discutir a Ucrânia com Xi e Putin durante a viagem.

sources.title: Trump floats Kim meeting in China, says he’ll discuss Ukraine with Xi and Putin
Trump says he could meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in China

en.headline: Trump says he would not mind Jensen Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO
en.body: The US president said many people would like to see Huang return as CEO. The Straits Times and The Hill reported the same position.

de.headline: Trump sagt, er würde es nicht mindern, wenn Jensen Huang erneut Nvidia-Chef wird
de.body: Der US-Präsident sagte, viele würden gerne sehen, dass Huang erneut CEO wird. Die Straits Times und The Hill berichteten über dieselbe Position.

es.headline: Trump dice que no le importaría que Jensen Huang volviera a ser CEO de Nvidia
es.body: El presidente de EE. UU. dijo que muchas personas querrían ver a Huang regresar al cargo de consejero delegado. The Straits Times y The Hill informaron la misma posición.

fr.headline: Trump déclare ne pas s'opposer au retour de Jensen Huang à la tête de Nvidia
fr.body: Le président américain a déclaré que beaucoup aimeraient voir Huang revenir à la tête de l'entreprise. The Straits Times et The Hill ont rapporté la même position.

it.headline: Trump dice che non dispiacerebbe se Jensen Huang tornasse a guidare Nvidia
it.body: Il presidente statunitense ha affermato che molte persone vorrebbero vedere Huang tornare a ricoprire il ruolo di amministratore delegato. Lo stesso posizionamento è stato riportato da The Straits Times e The Hill.

zh.headline: 特朗普表示不介意黄仁勋重任英伟达首席执行官
zh.body: 美国总统表示，许多人希望黄仁勋重返首席执行官职位。《海峡时报》和《希尔》报道了相同的立场。

pt.headline: Trump diz que não se importaria com a reintegração de Jensen Huang como CEO da Nvidia
pt.body: O presidente dos EUA disse que muitas pessoas gostariam de ver Huang regressar como CEO. O Straits Times e The Hill reportaram a mesma posição.

ja.headline: トランプ氏、ジェンセン・フアン氏がNvidia CEOに復帰しても構わないと発言
ja.body: 米国大統領は、多くの人々がフアン氏のCEO復帰を望んでいると述べた。ストraits TimesとThe Hillも同様の立場を報じている。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 CEO 복귀에 반대하지 않을 것이라 밝혀
ko.body: 미국 대통령은 많은 사람들이 황의 CEO 복귀를 바랄 것이라고 말했다. 스트레이츠 타임스와 더 힐은 같은 입장을 보도했다.

sources.title: Trump says he would not mind Jensen Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO
Live updates: Trump heads to Asia, backs calls for Huang’s reinstatement amid Nvidia scandal

en.headline: Trump says Nvidia scandal did not put U.S. national security at risk, defends Lutnick
en.body: President Trump told reporters before departing for a trip to Asia that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair did not put U.S. national security at risk. CNBC and CNBC reported the same comments.

de.headline: Trump sagt, Nvidia-Skandal gefährdete nicht die US-Sicherheit, verteidigt Lutnick
de.body: Präsident Trump sagte Reportern vor dem Abflug nach Asien, dass der frühere Nvidia-Chef Jensen Huang die Affäre nicht die US-Nationalsecurity gefährdet habe. CNBC und CNBC berichteten über dieselben Äußerungen.

es.headline: Trump afirma que el escándalo de Nvidia no puso en riesgo la seguridad nacional de EE. UU., defiende a Lutnick
es.body: El presidente Trump dijo a los periodistas antes de partir a un viaje a Asia que el affaire del antiguo CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, no puso en riesgo la seguridad nacional de EE. UU. CNBC y CNBC informaron los mismos comentarios.

fr.headline: Trump affirme que le scandale Nvidia ne mettait pas en danger la sécurité nationale, défend Lutnick
fr.body: Le président Trump a déclaré aux journalistes avant son départ pour un voyage en Asie que l'affaire de l'ancien PDG de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, n'avait pas mis la sécurité nationale des États-Unis en danger. CNBC et CNBC ont rapporté les mêmes propos.

it.headline: Trump afferma che lo scandalo Nvidia non ha messo a rischio la sicurezza nazionale degli Stati Uniti, difende Lutnick
it.body: Il presidente Trump ha dichiarato ai giornalisti prima della partenza per un viaggio in Asia che l'ex amministratore delegato di Nvidia Jensen Huang non ha messo a rischio la sicurezza nazionale degli Stati Uniti. Lo stesso contenuto è stato riportato da CNBC e CNBC.

zh.headline: 特朗普称英伟达丑闻未危及美国国家安全，为卢特尼克辩护
zh.body: 特朗普总统在启程前往亚洲之行前告诉记者，前英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的私事并未危及美国国家安全。《CNBC》报道了相同的言论。

pt.headline: Trump diz que o escândalo da Nvidia não colocou a segurança nacional dos EUA em risco, defende Lutnick
pt.body: O presidente Trump disse a repórteres antes de partir para uma viagem à Ásia que o caso do ex-CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, não colocou a segurança nacional dos EUA em risco. A CNBC e a CNBC reportaram os mesmos comentários.

ja.headline: トランプ氏、Nvidiaスキャンダルは米国の安全保障を脅かさず、ラトニック氏を擁護
ja.body: トランプ大統領はアジアへの出張に先立ち記者団に対し、元Nvidia CEOのジェンセン・フアン氏のスキャンダルは米国の安全保障を脅かさなかったと述べた。CNBCとCNBCが同様のコメントを報じている。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 엔비디아 스캔들이 미국 국가 안보에 위협이 되지 않았다고 주장하며 럿닉 옹호
ko.body: 트럼프 대통령은 아시아 출국 전 기자들에게 전 엔비디아 CEO 젠슨 황의 불륜이 미국 국가 안보에 위협이 되지 않았다고 말했다. CNBC와 CNBC는 같은 발언을 보도했다.

sources.title: President Trump says he 'wouldn't mind' Jensen Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO
Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker

en.headline: Xi, Trump and Putin to meet at Shenzhen summit
en.body: Chinese authorities stated that President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin will gather for a trilateral meeting in Shenzhen to discuss world peace and strategic stability. According to the Chinese foreign ministry, the agenda includes nuclear non-proliferation and the Middle East war.

fr.headline: Xi, Trump et Poutine se rencontreront lors d'un sommet à Shenzhen
fr.body: Les autorités chinoises ont indiqué que le président Xi Jinping, le président américain Donald Trump et le président russe Vladimir Putin se réuniraient pour une entrevue trilatérale à Shenzhen afin de discuter de la paix dans le monde et de la stabilité stratégique. Selon le ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères, l'ordre du jour comprend la non-prolifération nucléaire et la guerre au Moyen-Orient.

es.headline: Xi, Trump y Putin se reunirán en la cumbre de Shenzhen
es.body: Las autoridades chinas anunciaron que el presidente Xi Jinping, el presidente de EE. UU., Donald Trump, y el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, se reunirán en un encuentro trilateral en Shenzhen para debatir sobre la paz mundial y la estabilidad estratégica. Según el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino, la agenda incluye la no proliferación nuclear y la guerra en Oriente Medio.

it.headline: Xi, Trump e Putin si incontreranno al vertice di Shenzhen
it.body: Le autorità cinesi hanno dichiarato che il presidente Xi Jinping, il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump e il presidente russo Vladimir Putin si riuniranno per un incontro trilaterale a Shenzhen per discutere di pace mondiale e stabilità strategica. Secondo il ministero degli Esteri cinese, l'ordine del giorno include la non proliferazione nucleare e la guerra in Medio Oriente.

de.headline: Xi, Trump und Putin treffen sich zu Gipfel in Shenzhen
de.body: Chinesischen Behörden zufolge werden Präsident Xi Jinping, US-Präsident Donald Trump und der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin zu einem dreiseitigen Treffen in Shenzhen zusammenkommen, um über Weltfrieden und strategische Stabilität zu beraten. Nach Angaben des chinesischen Außenministeriums stehen die nukleare Nichtverbreitung und der Nahe-Ost-Krieg auf der Tagesordnung.

pt.headline: Xi, Trump e Putin vão reunir-se em cimeira em Shenzhen
pt.body: As autoridades chinesas afirmaram que o Presidente Xi Jinping, o Presidente norte-americano Donald Trump e o Presidente russo Vladimir Putin vão reunir-se num encontro trilateral em Shenzhen para debater a paz mundial e a estabilidade estratégica. De acordo com o ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros chinês, a agenda inclui a não-proliferação nuclear e a guerra no Médio Oriente.

zh.headline: 习近平、特朗普和普京将在深圳峰会会晤
zh.body: 中国官方表示，国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将在深圳举行三边会晤，讨论世界和平与战略稳定。中国外交部称，会议议题包括核不扩散以及中东战争。

ko.headline: 시진핑·트럼프·푸틴, 선전 정상회의서 회동
ko.body: 중국 당국은 시진핑 국가주석과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 세계 평화와 전략적 안정을 논의하기 위해 선전에서 3자 회담을 가질 것이라고 밝혔다. 중국 외교부에 따르면 이번 회의의 의제에는 핵확산 방지와 중동 전쟁이 포함된다.

ja.headline: 習氏、トランプ氏、プーチン氏が深圳サミットで会談へ
ja.body: 中国当局は、習近平国家主席、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領、ウラジーミル・プーチン露大統領が世界の平和と戦略的安定を協議するため、深圳での3国間会談に集まると発表した。中国外務省によると、議題には核不拡散や中東戦争が含まれているという。

Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss 'world peace' at Shenzhen summit, China says
China confirms Xi-Trump-Putin historic summit. What will be on the agenda?

en.headline: Tech leaders back Jensen Huang return to Nvidia
en.body: Elon Musk and other technology executives have joined calls supporting a potential comeback for former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following his resignation. According to reports, tech executives and major shareholders are backing his return as the company faces a wider AI sector sell-off.

fr.headline: Des figures de la tech soutiennent le retour de Jensen Huang chez Nvidia
fr.body: Elon Musk et d'autres dirigeants du secteur technologique se sont joints aux appels en faveur d'un éventuel retour de l'ancien PDG de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, à la suite de sa démission. Selon certaines informations, des chefs d'entreprise de la tech et de grands actionnaires soutiennent son retour alors que l'entreprise fait face à une vaste vague de ventes dans le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle.

es.headline: Líderes tecnológicos apoyan el regreso de Jensen Huang a Nvidia
es.body: Elon Musk y otros directivos del sector tecnológico se han sumado a las llamadas de apoyo a un posible regreso del ex consejero delegado de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, tras su dimisión. Según los informes, destacados empresarios tecnológicos y grandes accionistas respaldan su vuelta en un momento en que la empresa afronta una oleada generalizada de ventas en el sector de la inteligencia artificial.

it.headline: I leader tecnologici sostengono il ritorno di Jensen Huang a Nvidia
it.body: Elon Musk e altri dirigenti del settore tecnologico si sono uniti agli appelli a favore di un potenziale ritorno dell'ex amministratore delegato di Nvidia Jensen Huang in seguito alle sue dimissioni. Secondo quanto riferito, i vertici tecnologici e i principali azionisti appoggiano il suo rientro mentre l'azienda affronta una più ampia svendita nel settore dell'intelligenza artificiale.

de.headline: Tech-Führungskräfte unterstützen Rückkehr von Jensen Huang zu Nvidia
de.body: Elon Musk und andere Technologiemanager haben sich Forderungen angeschlossen, die ein mögliches Comeback des früheren Nvidia-Chefs Jensen Huang nach dessen Rücktritt unterstützen. Berichten zufolge befürworten Führungskräfte aus der Tech-Branche und große Anteilseigner seine Rückkehr, während das Unternehmen mit einem breiteren Ausverkauf im KI-Sektor konfrontiert ist.

pt.headline: Líderes tecnológicos apoiam o regresso de Jensen Huang à Nvidia
pt.body: Elon Musk e outros executivos tecnológicos juntaram-se aos apelos que apoiam um potencial regresso do antigo presidente executivo da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, na sequência da sua demissão. Segundo relatos, executivos do setor tecnológico e grandes acionistas estão a apoiar o seu regresso enquanto a empresa enfrenta uma vaga de vendas generalizada no setor da inteligência artificial.

zh.headline: 科技界领袖支持黄仁勋重返英伟达
zh.body: 埃隆·马斯克和其他科技界高管纷纷发声，支持英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋在辞职后可能回归。据报道，在公司面临人工智能板块遭遇更广泛抛售之际，科技高管和大股东正支持他回归。

ko.headline: 테크 업계 리더들, 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 복귀 지지
ko.body: 일론 머스크를 비롯한 기술 기업 임원들이 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 사임 이후 제기된 잠재적 복귀 지지 움직임에 동참했다. 보도에 따르면, 회사가 광범위한 AI 부문 매도세를 겪는 가운데 기술 업계 경영진과 주요 주주들이 그의 복귀를 지지하고 있다.

ja.headline: テック業界リーダー、ジェンスン・フアン氏のエヌビディア復帰を支持
ja.body: イーロン・マスク氏をはじめとするテクノロジー企業の経営者らが、エヌビディアの前CEOであるジェンスン・フアン氏の辞任を受けた復帰の可能性を支持する動きに加わった。報道によると、AI（人工知能）セクター全体の売りが広がる中、テック企業の経営者や大株主らが同氏の復帰を後押ししているという。

en.dek: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's involvement in a major spy scandal intersects with President Trump's high-stakes diplomatic trip to Asia following midterm defeats.

de.title: Jensen-Huang-Spionageskandal und Trump-Asientour
de.dek: Die Verwicklung von Nvidia-Chef Jensen Huang in einen großen Spionageskandal überschneidet sich mit der diplomatischen Risikoreise von Präsident Trump nach Asien im Anschluss an die Zwischenwahlen.

it.title: Scandalo spionaggio di Jensen Huang e tour asiatico di Trump
it.dek: Il coinvolgimento del CEO di Nvidia Jensen Huang in un importante scandalo di spionaggio si intreccia con la delicata missione diplomatica del Presidente Trump in Asia, successiva alle sconfitte nelle elezioni di metà mandato.

es.title: Escándalo de espionaje de Jensen Huang y gira de Trump por Asia

en.title: Trump heads to Asia for Shenzhen summit as Nvidia board rejects Huang return
en.dek: US President Donald Trump departs for China ahead of a summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, while Nvidia's board rejects calls to reinstate Jensen Huang.
facts: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet in Shenzhen on 19 November.
Trump administration implemented new restrictions on remote access to advanced AI chips for overseas data centers serving China.
The Nvidia board of directors is not considering reinstating former CEO Jensen Huang, according to a source cited by CNBC.
President Trump stated that Huang's affair did not put US national security at risk, contradicting reports from US intelligence officials.
Trump is traveling to Asia with Cabinet members Howard Lutnick and Scott Bessent, who hold opposing views on China.
body: US President Donald Trump has departed for Asia ahead of a trilateral summit scheduled for 19 November in Shenzhen, China. Chinese authorities confirmed that Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will gather to address strategic stability, nuclear non-proliferation, denuclearization, trade, and the conflicts in Ukraine, Iran, and the Middle East. Trump also stated before his departure that he might meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his trip to China.

The US administration has placed new restrictions on overseas data centers providing remote access to advanced artificial intelligence chips to China. According to reports from The Hill and DW, federal officials cited the recent Nvidia espionage controversy as the reason for the policy change. While US intelligence officials reportedly concluded that Alice Huang acted as a Chinese spy, Trump told reporters that Jensen Huang's affair did not put national security at risk.

Nvidia's board of directors is not considering bringing former chief executive Jensen Huang back to his role, according to a source cited by CNBC. The board's stance comes despite lobbying from Elon Musk, major shareholders, and other technology executives who supported Huang's reinstatement following his resignation. Market analysts reported to Al Jazeera that Nvidia risks a potential 30 percent decline in market value without Huang leading the company.

The US president noted that many industry figures supported Huang's comeback and stated he would not mind if Huang returned as chief executive. While tech allies set up a dedicated group to lobby for Huang's reinstatement amid a broader AI stock sell-off, Nvidia's board has maintained its leadership transition. Semafor reported that the US does not plan to restrict foreign technology firms operating inside allied nations.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent are traveling with Trump on the trip to Asia. Trump told Fox News that the two Cabinet officials maintain opposing views regarding trade and foreign policy toward China. Lutnick has faced separate public questions regarding his sons' firm and its ties to Nvidia.

The Shenzhen meeting was organized by Beijing as a forum for the three world leaders to address global security concerns. State media reported that the summit will focus on trade policy alongside international diplomatic conflicts.
en.context: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive officer of Nvidia following reports of an affair involving a suspected Chinese intelligence agent, triggering leadership changes and market volatility across the artificial intelligence sector. The trilateral gathering in Shenzhen on 19 November brings together the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States.

en.dek: Chinese authorities confirmed a trilateral summit in Shenzhen while tech executives lobby for Jensen Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia.
facts: Chinese authorities announced a trilateral summit in Shenzhen for Xi, Trump, and Putin to discuss nuclear non-proliferation and the Middle East war.

Trump said he would not mind Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO.
body: Chinese authorities announced that President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will gather in Shenzhen for a trilateral meeting to discuss world peace and strategic stability. According to the Chinese foreign ministry, the agenda includes nuclear non-proliferation and the Middle East war.

Elon Musk and other technology executives have joined calls supporting a potential comeback for former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following his resignation. According to reports, tech executives and major shareholders are backing his return as the company faces a wider AI sector sell-off.
President Trump told reporters before departing for a trip to Asia that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair did not put U.S. national security at risk. CNBC and CNBC reported the same comments.
The US president said many people would like to see Huang return as CEO. The Straits Times and The Hill reported the same position.

The meeting in Shenzhen follows a series of diplomatic developments involving the three nations. Chinese state media confirmed the summit, noting that the leaders will address strategic stability and international security concerns.

Tech industry allies have reportedly established a group to lobby for Huang's return to his former position. This effort coincides with market volatility affecting Nvidia and other companies within the AI sector.
Shareholders and industry figures continue to monitor the leadership situation at Nvidia. The company has faced pressure as investors react to the recent changes in executive management.
en.context: Jensen Huang resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia amid a period of market instability for AI-focused technology firms. The Shenzhen summit marks a rare meeting between the leaders of China, the United States, and Russia.

de.title: Xi, Trump und Putin treffen sich in Shenzhen, während Tech-Führungskräfte die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang fordern
de.dek: US-Präsident Donald Trump wird gemeinsam mit dem chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping und dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin an einem trilateralen Gipfel teilnehmen, während Tech-Führungskräfte für die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang werben.
facts: Chinesische Beamte kündigten einen trilateralen Gipfel in Shenzhen für Xi, Trump und Putin an.
Die Tagesordnung des Gipfels umfasst nukleare Nichtverbreitung und den Krieg im Nahen Osten.
Elon Musk und andere Tech-Führungskräfte unterstützen öffentlich die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang zu Nvidia.
Nvidia erlebt derzeit einen branchenweiten Ausverkauf von Aktien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz.
body: Die chinesischen Behörden gaben bekannt, dass Präsident Xi Jinping, US-Präsident Donald Trump und der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin zu einem trilateralen Treffen in Shenzhen zusammenkommen werden. Das chinesische Außenministerium erklärte, die Staatschefs beabsichtigen, über Weltfrieden, nukleare Nichtverbreitung und den anhaltenden Krieg im Nahen Osten zu beraten.

Elon Musk und andere Führungskräfte aus der Technologiebranche haben sich den Forderungen nach einer Wiedereinsetzung des ehemaligen Nvidia-CEO Jensen Huang angeschlossen. Berichten zufolge organisieren sich diese Führungskräfte und Großaktionäre, um seine Rückkehr zu unterstützen, während das Unternehmen einen breiteren Ausverkauf im Sektor der künstlichen Intelligenz durchläuft.

Das Treffen in Shenzhen folgt auf eine Reihe diplomatischer Entwicklungen zwischen den drei Nationen. Chinesische Staatsmedien bestätigten den Gipfel und merkten an, dass die Staatschefs Fragen der strategischen Stabilität und internationale Sicherheitsbedenken erörtern werden.

Verbündete aus der Tech-Industrie haben Berichten zufolge eine Gruppe gegründet, um für Huangs Rückkehr auf seine frühere Position zu lobbyieren. Diese Bemühungen fallen mit der Marktvolatilität zusammen, die Nvidia und andere Unternehmen im KI-Sektor betrifft.
Der Gipfel stellt ein bedeutendes diplomatisches Treffen zwischen den drei Weltmächten dar. Beamte haben noch keinen genauen Beginn für die Gespräche in Shenzhen genannt.
Aktionäre und Branchenvertreter beobachten weiterhin die Führungssituation bei Nvidia. Das Unternehmen steht unter Druck, da Investoren auf die jüngsten Veränderungen im Management reagieren.
de.context: Jensen Huang trat inmitten einer Phase der Marktinstabilität für KI-fokussierte Technologiefirmen von seiner Position als CEO von Nvidia zurück. Der Gipfel in Shenzhen markiert ein seltenes Treffen zwischen den Staatschefs Chinas, der Vereinigten Staaten und Russlands.
